title: PaCoRe: Learning to Scale Test-Time Compute with Parallel Coordinated Reasoning
authors_zh: Jingcheng Hu、Heung-Yeung Shum（清华大学）；Yinmin Zhang、Shijie Shang、Xiaobo Yang、Yue Peng、Zhewei Huang、Hebin Zhou、Xin Wu、Jie Cheng、Fanqi Wan、Xiangwen Kong、Chengyuan Yao、Kaiwen Yan、Ailin Huang、Hongyu Zhou、Qi Han、Zheng Ge、Daxin Jiang、Xiangyu Zhang（StepFun）；Xiaobo Yang（北京大学）
paper_type_zh: 并行协同测试时扩展与强化学习研究
best_for_zh: 研究超越顺序上下文长度限制的大预算推理系统的读者。
one_line: PaCoRe coordinates large parallel trajectory pools through compact messages, allowing multi-million-token effective reasoning without exceeding a model’s context window.
PaCoRe 用多轮并行轨迹与压缩消息协调推理，在不超出上下文窗口的情况下扩展到数百万级有效测试时令牌。
why: It makes cross-trajectory synthesis a learned test-time capability and reports scaling curves at explicitly stated token budgets.
inclusion_reason: It directly studies how coordinated parallel breadth and message compression can scale effective test-time computation beyond a fixed context window.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A fixed context window limits ordinary sequential reasoning: every intermediate thought consumes the same ever-growing prompt, so search eventually stops even if more useful computation is available. Independent parallel samples avoid that depth limit, but a model may ignore their insights, fall back on majority voting, or solve the problem again from scratch rather than synthesizing the useful parts of many attempts.

PaCoRe asks how to scale effective test-time computation far beyond sequential context length while preserving a usable coordination channel. It targets a multi-round record in which many trajectories are compressed into compact messages, those messages guide the next round, and the final answer is produced by learned synthesis rather than an unstructured vote over candidates.

固定上下文窗口限制普通顺序推理：每个中间思考都会消耗同一个不断增长的提示，因此即使仍有有用计算，搜索也终会停止。独立并行样本避开了深度限制，但模型可能忽略其中洞见，退化为多数投票，或从头再解问题，而不是综合多次尝试中的有用部分。

PaCoRe 研究如何在保持可用协调通道的前提下，把有效测试时计算扩展到远超顺序上下文长度。它面向多轮记录：许多轨迹被压缩为紧凑消息，消息引导下一轮，最终答案由学习得到的综合生成，而不是对候选做无结构投票。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
PaCoRe changes the main source of scaling from one long chain to coordinated breadth. In each round, the model receives the problem plus compact messages distilled from the prior round, generates K parallel reasoning trajectories, then turns their findings into a new bounded message set. A final round with one trajectory is the answer-synthesis stage.

The authors train the model with large-scale outcome-based reinforcement learning so it learns to use the messages instead of ignoring them. The key object is therefore not raw trajectory accumulation: it is the message interface between rounds, which preserves selected findings under a fixed context limit while allowing total work across all branches to become very large.

PaCoRe 将扩展的主要来源从一条长链改为协调的宽度。每一轮中，模型接收问题和从前一轮提炼出的紧凑消息，生成 K 条并行推理轨迹，再把这些发现变成新的有界消息集合。最后一轮只有一条轨迹，承担答案综合。

作者用大规模结果式强化学习训练模型，使其学会使用消息而不是忽略消息。因此关键对象不是原始轨迹累积，而是轮次之间的消息接口：它在固定上下文限制下保留选定发现，同时允许所有分支上的总工作量非常大。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a problem x, the inference pipeline executes R rounds. Round r takes x and the previous compact message set, generates Kr full reasoning trajectories, and compacts their findings into messages for the next round. The final round is a degenerate K=1 synthesis. The reported low, medium, and high configurations are [4], [16], and [32,4], respectively, making the width and number of coordination rounds explicit parts of the budget.

Training uses outcome-based RL to teach cross-trajectory synthesis. Evaluation covers mathematics, coding, science, and open-ended tasks, reports total effective test-time tokens, and compares against RLVR-8B and frontier models. The paper releases checkpoints, training data, and full inference code, which allows a reproduction to inspect message prompts, trajectory sampling, cached first-round pools, and the exact relation between total branch tokens and final context length.

对问题 x，推理流水线执行 R 轮。第 r 轮接收 x 和前一轮紧凑消息集合，生成 Kr 条完整推理轨迹，并把发现压缩为供下一轮使用的消息。最后一轮是 K=1 的退化综合。所报告的低、中、高配置分别为 [4]、[16] 和 [32,4]，使宽度和协调轮次成为预算的显式部分。

训练使用结果式 RL 教会跨轨迹综合。评测覆盖数学、代码、科学和开放任务，报告总有效测试时令牌，并与 RLVR-8B 和前沿模型比较。论文发布检查点、训练数据和完整推理代码，复现者可检查消息提示、轨迹采样、缓存首轮池，以及总分支令牌和最终上下文长度之间的确切关系。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
At the reported high [32,4] setting, PaCoRe-8B reaches 94.5% on HMMT 2025 with 1.796 million effective tokens per problem, compared with the table’s 93.2% GPT-5 reference at 16 thousand tokens. The same table reports 78.4% on IMO-AnswerBench at 2.258 million tokens and gives low and medium budget points, so the paper presents an actual scaling curve rather than a single best-of-N comparison.

The evidence also identifies the cost boundary: the gain is bought with orders of magnitude more aggregate computation, even though the model context window is not exceeded. PaCoRe low already reaches 88.1% on HMMT with 243 thousand tokens, versus 75.4% for the RLVR-8B baseline at 48 thousand. These numbers support coordinated breadth under stated budgets, not a claim of lower total compute than frontier systems.

在所报告的高 [32,4] 配置下，PaCoRe-8B 在 HMMT 2025 上达到 94.5%，每题使用 179.6 万有效令牌；表中 GPT-5 参考为 93.2%、每题 1.6 万令牌。同一表在 225.8 万令牌下报告 IMO-AnswerBench 的 78.4%，并给出低、中预算点，因此论文呈现的是实际标度曲线，而非单一 Best-of-N 比较。

证据也明确成本边界：收益是以高出数个数量级的聚合计算换来的，尽管模型上下文窗口没有被超过。PaCoRe 低配置在 24.3 万令牌下已在 HMMT 达到 88.1%，而 RLVR-8B 基线在 4.8 万令牌下为 75.4%。这些数字支持所述预算下的协调宽度，而不主张总计算低于前沿系统。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most parallel test-time methods either select one completed answer or concatenate too much branch history into the next prompt. PaCoRe makes compression and synthesis a trained capability: compact messages are the state passed between rounds, and the model is trained to recover useful cross-branch evidence even when no individual trajectory is sufficient. This is the mechanism intended to break the direct coupling between context length and total reasoning volume.

The novelty is not parallel sampling alone, and not simply RLVR. It is a learned coordination interface whose behavior must be assessed at equal message, branch, and token budgets. Before reuse, readers should check whether message compression loses crucial evidence, whether the model truly synthesizes rather than votes, and whether cached first-round trajectories change the online-cost interpretation.

多数并行测试时方法要么选择一个完成答案，要么把过多分支历史拼接进下一提示。PaCoRe 将压缩和综合设为经训练的能力：紧凑消息是轮次间传递的状态，模型被训练为即使没有单条轨迹足够时，也能恢复有用的跨分支证据。这是意图打破上下文长度与总推理量直接耦合的机制。

新意不只是并行采样，也不只是 RLVR，而是一个学习得到的协调接口；其行为应在消息、分支和令牌预算对齐时评估。复用前，读者应检查消息压缩是否丢失关键证据、模型是否真正综合而非投票，以及缓存的首轮轨迹是否改变在线成本解释。

title: Limitations
局限
html: PaCoRe removes a context-window ceiling but not a compute ceiling: high settings consume millions of aggregate tokens per problem and require extensive parallel serving. Message compression can omit decisive detail, and learned synthesis may ignore useful messages or propagate a shared error across rounds. The evaluation uses cached first-round trajectories for efficiency, so reproduction should distinguish that experimental device from fully online generation. Any production deployment needs explicit aggregate-token, latency, and cost caps.
PaCoRe 移除了上下文窗口上限，却没有移除计算上限：高配置每题消耗数百万聚合令牌，并需要大量并行服务。消息压缩可能遗漏决定性细节，学习得到的综合也可能忽略有用消息，或跨轮传播共同错误。评测为效率使用缓存首轮轨迹，因此复现应区分这种实验装置和完全在线生成。任何生产部署都需要显式的聚合令牌、延迟和成本上限。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use PaCoRe when a task warrants massive aggregate inference but a single context cannot hold all search history. The essential logging unit is a round: message set in, trajectories generated, messages retained, synthesis output, and total tokens across all branches. The released pipeline makes it a strong reproducibility target, but comparisons should always include both final-context length and total effective compute, since the framework is designed to make those quantities diverge.
当任务值得投入巨大聚合推理、但单一上下文无法容纳全部搜索历史时，可使用 PaCoRe。必要的记录单位是一轮：输入消息集合、生成轨迹、保留消息、综合输出以及所有分支的总令牌。发布的流水线使其成为很强的可复现目标，但比较时应同时包含最终上下文长度和总有效计算，因为该框架正是让这两项分离。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: PaCoRe scales coordinated breadth, not just answer count. The compact message is the critical state object, and outcome-based RL is used to teach the model to exploit that state. Its strongest result is HMMT 2025 at high aggregate compute; the corresponding token cost must travel with the accuracy. The release includes checkpoints, data, and inference code, making it appropriate for auditing whether synthesis—not simple majority voting—creates the observed scaling behavior.
PaCoRe 扩展的是协调宽度，而非仅答案数量。紧凑消息是关键状态对象，结果式 RL 用来教模型利用该状态。其最强结果是高聚合计算下的 HMMT 2025，相应令牌成本必须与准确率一同报告。发布包含检查点、数据和推理代码，适合审计观测到的标度行为是否由综合而非简单多数投票造成。
